description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: Add dark mode toggle (#12)
- docs: Update install guide (#15)
- bug: Fix crash on empty input (#14)
- refactor: Split parser module (#16)
- feature: Add CSV export (#18)
- bug: Fix timezone offset (#19)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)', grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group (refactor mapped to CHORE).

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- bug: Fix broken link in footer (#21)
- feature: Add keyboard shortcuts
- docs: Clarify config options
evals.expected_output: Lines '- [FEAT] Add keyboard shortcuts (#none)' and '- [DOCS] Clarify config options (#none)' are rendered with (#none); the bullet with an issue number keeps its id; groups ordered FEAT, FIX, DOCS.
